WWW-Authenticate.description: The challenge: Bearer, the scheme the admin token is presented in (docs/API.md section 5).

X-Request-Id.description: The request id: the caller's own X-Request-Id echoed (trimmed, cut to 128 bytes, non-printable characters dropped) when one survives that, else a ULID the node minted. Equal to error.request_id on an error. The join key between the caller's log, the node's log and the audit row (docs/API.md section 4).

X-Tmesis-Node.description: The name of the node that answered (node.name).

X-Tmesis-Version.description: The BUILD version of the node that answered (dev for an unstamped build). Not the contract version, which is info.version here and contract_version on GET /api/v1/health.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; send it back as cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

held.description: True while any hold reason stands: local files are kept.

hold_reasons.description: Why the local files are kept, independent of transfer state, in this order: not_finalized, retention_clock_unknown, retention_not_elapsed, copies_incomplete, release_required, writer_active, recovery_active, transfer_active, master_pending, local_integrity_failed, retirement_failed. master_pending (since v0.8.0) is a recording_ingest source of a queued or running told master. A purged generation (purge_requested_at set) carries neither retention reason. Empty means the next retirement pass may remove the generation's local files.

inventory_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the committed inventory, 64 lowercase hex digits; null until finalized. Every mutation names it.

job_id.description: The transcode job a job generation belongs to (job_* kinds, ^job_<ULID>$); null for a stream generation.

local_present.description: Whether the generation's local files are on this node.

master.description: The told master's request and progress (POST .../masters) on a recording_master generation; null on every other kind.

plan_revision.description: The current plan revision; 0 is the empty baseline written at finalisation, never a release. Null until finalized.

purge_requested_at.description: When an operator purge (POST .../purge) was recorded on the current decision: the next retirement pass may remove the local files from then on, whatever retention_expires_at says (which a purge never changes). Null when none was.

recording_id.description: The recording a recording generation belongs to; null for hls_sealed and every job kind.

registered_at.description: When a recording registered; its retention counts from here. Null for hls_sealed and for a recording not yet registered.

retention_expires_at.description: The earliest retention eligibility, durable and only ever raised. Null is UNKNOWN (a recording that never registered): the generation is held with retention_clock_unknown, never zero.

session.description: The publish session; null for a job generation.

session_epoch.description: The session's epoch; null for a job generation.

stream.description: The stream the generation came from; null for a job generation (job_id is set).

format.description: aac in M4A, mp3 in MP3, opus in Ogg. Omitted is aac.

authorization_revision.description: The next refresh is the object's authorization_revision plus 1. The current one again is a retry: 200 when its bundle is identical, 409 request_conflict when it differs, and after a restart 200 with authorization_available false (send the next revision).

multipart_upload_id.description: The object's upload id; null before a multipart upload has one.

plan_revision.description: The object's plan revision. A replaced revision is 409 transfer_identity_mismatch.

requests.description: Merged into the object's in-memory bundle; a null operation is not supplied, never a revocation.

admission.description: CLOSED set. Live unit admission, the health live_capacity.admission value.

benchmark_ran_at.description: When the stored live measurement was taken (health live_capacity.measured_at). Null when no record was read.

device_sessions_total.description: The NVENC/QSV encoder session ceiling of a stored record matching this box. Null when none is known.

device_sessions_used.description: Encoder sessions held on the device: live sessions plus running job encoders.

encode_slots_total.description: The live unit limit while admission is on; 0 while it is off or not applicable, meaning nobody measured, never no capacity.

encode_slots_used.description: Units held by live sessions, counted whether or not admission is on.

max_streams.description: The told limits.max_streams; 0 when the stored measurement decides.

measured.description: True only for source measured: the stored tmesis bench --profile live measurement, valid for this box.

pending_milestone.description: Always empty since v0.9.0, which fills this block; kept for compatibility.

source.description: CLOSED set. Where the limits came from, the health live_capacity.source value.

unit_ladder.description: The ladder one unit is one session of; empty when not applicable.

fallback.description: connecting, live and degraded: true while this session runs on transcription.fallback_provider, false on the primary. Null while idle and when ended: the role is a fact of the running config, not of the journal.

provider.description: The STT provider of this session: deepgram or self_hosted. connecting, live and degraded: the provider the current session uses, or the one the next opens on after a switch. ended: the provider of the last cue journaled for the publish session, null when none was. Null while idle.

reason.description: The degraded or ended reason, in caption.session_ended's vocabulary; null while the session is idle, connecting or live.

state.description: CLOSED set. idle: no caption session runs: the stream is not publishing, captions are off, or (since v0.9.3) captions are on while the box's captioned capacity is full and no fallback can take the stream, which a captions.skipped timeline event names. degraded: the provider is not answering, or (reason stalled, since v0.9.3) audio is flowing and it answered none of it, answered too late or lost too much of it; it returns to live by itself when the provider answers again (a caption.session_started with resumed_after), unless reason is auth_error or quota_exceeded, which need an operator. On a node with a transcription.fallback_provider a degraded stream may come back on the other provider instead (a caption.session_started with switched_from), a refused key included. connecting: a socket is being opened, which includes the moment after a provider switch until the new provider's socket opens. ended: the session closed with the show.

keyterms.description: The stream's provisioned keyterms, normalised; an empty array when it named none. A live session uses the keyterms hook's answer instead once a configured hook has answered.

languages.description: The effective caption languages, [transcription.language] when the stream named none. Exactly one in v1.

provider.description: The effective STT provider, resolved to the node's transcription.provider when the stream named none; none on a node with no provider. It is the node's primary: with a transcription.fallback_provider the session record (include=captions) names the provider the current session uses.

session.description: The provider session for the current publish, present only with include=captions and only while captions are on for the stream.

advertise.description: Write the EXT-X-MEDIA TYPE=SUBTITLES group into both masters (next_segment). The writer runs whenever enabled is on, so the DVR and the transcript are complete for a show that chose not to advertise live. Omitted or null is true.

enabled.description: Open a provider session for this stream and write the caption rendition (next_segment). The cost control: a captioning stream streams audio to the provider for the whole session, silence included. Omitted or null is off. 422 on a node whose transcription.provider is none, on a passthrough node, or on a ladder with no audio_only rung.

keyterms.description: The show's vocabulary the STT provider is told to favour: fighter names, promotion, venue, city (next_segment; a live change reaches the open provider session without a gap where the provider supports it). At most 100 terms, each 1 to 50 characters after trimming, no control characters; duplicates are removed case-insensitively, keeping the first spelling and the order. 422 on captions.keyterms over the node provider's own cap (Deepgram: about 500 tokens, estimated conservatively). A list replaces the stored one, an empty array or null clears it, omitted keeps it. A configured keyterms hook's answer replaces this list for a live session once it has answered.

languages.description: RFC 5646 tags to caption in. v1 accepts exactly one (two or more is 422 naming multi-language as later); empty, omitted or null is the node's transcription.language.

provider.description: The STT provider, or null for the node's configured transcription.provider. A non-null value must equal it (422 on captions.provider otherwise): deepgram or self_hosted. Since v0.9.2 a node may also name a transcription.fallback_provider, and failover applies to the stream either way: this field names the primary, never the fallback.

captions.description: The live captions object (docs/API.md 9.4). Objects merge one level deep on a PATCH; every field is next_segment.

dvr_window_seconds.description: RESERVED at v1: a value on a create, or any mention on a PATCH, answers 501 naming M4. The effective value is 0, the full window.

fallback.description: The fallback object (docs/API.md 9.4). Only end_seconds is acted on by this build. Objects merge one level deep on a PATCH.

id.description: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,127}$, no dots (docs/API.md section 4). Idempotent: re-POSTing an id with the same desired config is 200.

labels.description: Opaque string-to-string map the node never interprets, echoed in every webhook for this stream. At most 16 keys, 64-byte keys, 256-byte values. Null on a PATCH unsets to {}.

ladder.description: A ladder in encode.ladders, or 422 on a name this node does not have. Omitted resolves to encode.default_ladder; null on a PATCH unsets a stored value (next_session).

min_key_epoch.description: Reject publish keys below this epoch, 0 or greater (docs/API.md 8.2). Omitted or null is no floor at all, which is not the same as a floor of 0.

preview.description: The low-delay preview object (docs/API.md 9.4). Objects merge one level deep on a PATCH.

recording.description: The recording object: the ingest copy (docs/API.md 9.4). The told master is a request, POST .../masters, never a per-stream setting. Objects merge one level deep on a PATCH.

relays.description: Told forward destinations, each as POST .../relays takes it. WRITE ONLY: read them on GET .../relays. On a PATCH the array REPLACES what this record provisioned, and null is the same instruction as [] (provision none); omitted leaves the set alone.

segment_seconds.description: 1 to 30, and a multiple of every video rung's keyframe_seconds on the effective ladder (422 otherwise). Omitted is the ladder's own; null on a PATCH unsets the override (next_session).

webhook_url.description: This stream's webhook URL. Null (or omitted) means the node default from webhooks.url; an empty string is 422.

actor.description: Derived from the credential the request presented; a supplied actor field is refused.

current.description: Whether this decision is on the current plan revision. A later plan makes the generation unreleased again.

purge_reason.description: The purge's reason; null when none was recorded.

purge_requested_at.description: When an operator purge was recorded on this decision; retirement may begin from then, before retention_expires_at. Null when none was.

retention_expires_at.description: Retention still applies: a decision authorises eventual cleanup, not immediate unlinking. Null is an unknown deadline, which holds the generation.

resolved_fps.description: the rate this rung was pinned to for the session, as a rational string; compare against fps, which is measured

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, snake_case. Branch on this, never on message.

details.description: Per-field problems, one per invalid path, on 422; the obligation list (path obligations.<kind>, message <id>: <detail>) on 409 leave_obligations; null otherwise.

message.description: One human sentence. May change between builds.

milestone.description: Set only on 501: the milestone that delivers this route. Null otherwise.

path.description: Dotted path into the request body

details.description: The kind's own JSON object, or null.

level.description: The journal's three levels; AppendEvent refuses any other.

end_seconds.description: The effective seconds a held session of this stream waits for a rejoin: the stream's own value, else the node's fallback.end_seconds.

chain.description: RESERVED: lands at M5 with splicing; any value, null included, answers 501 naming it.

end_seconds.description: Seconds a held session waits for its publisher to rejoin before the node seals it, 1 or more (422 below that). Live: raising it during a hold extends that hold, lowering it seals at the new deadline (at once if that has passed). Omitted or null is the node's fallback.end_seconds.

hold_seconds.description: RESERVED: lands at M4 with the slate layer; any value, null included, answers 501 naming it.

slate_asset.description: RESERVED: lands at M5 with splicing; any value, null included, answers 501 naming it.

force.description: Skip the obligations (never the drain barrier). Every abandoned item is logged at WARN by kind and id, and the enrollment's unacked fleet events are expired with reason left.

abandoned.description: What --force abandoned; empty when nothing was owed.

expired_fleet_events.description: Unacked fleet events --force expired with reason left.

fleet_file_removed.description: Whether the node removed /etc/tmesis/fleet.json. Always false from this route: the service cannot write /etc (ProtectSystem=full), so the caller (tmesis leave, as root) removes it. The node is not enrolled either way once this answers 200.

node_id.description: The node id the control plane knew this box by.

admission.description: Whether this node admits new publishes and jobs (v0.7.0 D3): draining is in place with the process up (a fleet drain command), shutting_down is the SIGTERM drain.

capacity.description: Job slots and their use. Null until tmesis bench --profile job has measured this box (or jobs.max_concurrent pins a number): an unmeasured box runs one job and reports null, never 0.

config_source.description: CLOSED set: the RULE that picked the config file, never the file. defaults is a real answer for a zero-config box, never null.

degraded_reasons.description: CLOSED set. Always present, empty when status is ok. Degraded is NOT unhealthy: a degraded node is carrying a show. encoder_unavailable: the pinned live encoder (encode.video_encoder) is not usable and every publish is refused; jobs_encoder_unavailable: the pinned jobs encoder (jobs.video_encoder) is not usable and job submissions are refused; transcription_unavailable: a configured transcription provider, live or batch, has not been working for 30 seconds in a row (the transcription list names which). Captions fail soft: ready stays true and no show is touched.

disk.description: Null when the free space probe failed: an unreadable filesystem is not a full one.

ingest.description: Honest state of the media path, separate from status: a process can be alive and accept no publishers.

jobs.description: Transcode job counts. Null when the node has no job engine or the job table cannot be read, never 0 as a stand-in for unknown.

jobs_video_engine.description: What VOD transcode jobs encode with (jobs.video_encoder), the same fields as video_engine. Null when jobs are off.

live_capacity.description: The node's live capacity: unit admission, its source, and both ledgers' limits and use. Never null; capacity above stays the job slots.

ready.description: Startup finished: journal open, orphans reaped, listeners bound. This is the field a load balancer reads.

transcription.description: One entry per configured transcription role (live first, then batch), each naming the provider instance serving it and whether it works. Always present, empty when both providers are none, never null.

video_engine.description: What this box selected to encode its LIVE ladder with, probed at boot. Null when the node encodes no live stream (no ladder configured, or the transcoder role), which is not the same as encoding on the CPU.

paused.description: The jobs pause in force: no queued job is claimed until it ends, running jobs finish. Null when no pause is active.

running.description: Claimed and running jobs together: a claimed job holds a slot.

slots.description: How many jobs may be claimed or running at once: jobs.max_concurrent, else the stored tmesis bench --profile job measurement, else 1.

source.description: fleet: the control plane's desired state (jobs_pause). api: PUT /api/v1/transcode/pause.

until.description: When the pause ends by itself; null until cleared.

outbox_depth.description: Undelivered webhooks. A rising number means a receiver is down, never that media is affected.

admission.description: CLOSED set. on: a publish past encode_slots_total is refused over_capacity. off: every publish is admitted and still counted (unmeasured, stale or insufficient), while a known device ceiling still refuses. not_applicable: the node does not encode live (passthrough or transcoder).

caption_sessions_total.description: Since v0.9.3. The self-hosted captioned streams this box admits: the caption step's measured count less one stream of headroom (never below 1 for a measured 1 or more), 0 when the step measured 0 (the sidecar cannot carry one captioned stream). Past it a stream's captions start on transcription.fallback_provider (a caption.session_started with switched_from) or the stream runs uncaptioned. Null when no self_hosted provider serves live captions, or the caption step was never measured or does not apply to this sidecar (captions are then admitted without a limit).

caption_sessions_used.description: Since v0.9.3. Captioned slots held: streams whose live captions run on the self-hosted sidecar now. Null whenever caption_sessions_total is null.

device_sessions_total.description: The NVENC/QSV encoder session ceiling from a stored record that matches this box. Null when no ceiling is known.

device_sessions_used.description: Encoder sessions held on the device: live sessions plus running job encoders.

encode_slots_total.description: The unit limit while admission is on. Null whenever admission is not on, never 0 as a stand-in for unknown.

encode_slots_used.description: Units held by live sessions. Always counted, admission on or off.

measured_at.description: RFC3339 UTC: when the stored record was measured, a stale one included. Null when no record was read.

source.description: CLOSED set. measured: the stored tmesis bench --profile live measurement, valid for this box. configured: a told limits.max_streams. unmeasured: no record. stale: a record of another box, or an unreadable one. insufficient: the measurement found the box cannot hold one session. not_applicable with admission not_applicable.

unit_ladder.description: The ladder one unit is one session of: the stored record's unit ladder, else encode.default_ladder. Empty when not applicable.

provisioned.description: Unsealed registry rows. Null when the registry could not be read; never 0 as a stand-in for unknown.

detail.description: The newest failure in the node's words (the end reason and the status or network error), never a response body and never a key; for a provider that refused the key or the account (auth_error, quota_exceeded) on a node with transcription.fallback_provider set, that refusal, kept with state down until tmesis restarts even after later successes; on a node with no fallback a refusal is an ordinary failure and later successes read up. Null while up or unknown.

endpoint.description: The resolved endpoint this role's requests go to, as scheme://host:port/path: never a key, never a query. Two roles with the same endpoint share one instance and report the same state.

provider.description: The configured provider for this role: deepgram or self_hosted.

role.description: CLOSED set. live: transcription.provider, live captions. batch: transcription.batch_provider, VOD transcript outputs. fallback (since v0.9.2): transcription.fallback_provider, the live provider a stream's captions move to while the live one is not working; present only when one is configured, and its outage marks the node degraded, never not ready.

since.description: RFC3339 UTC: when state last changed. Null while unknown.

state.description: CLOSED set. up: the instance did the work within its freshness window (for self_hosted, its readiness probe answered ok and no newer request failed). down: it did not (no answer, a refusal, a server error, a failed readiness probe). unknown: no fresh evidence, which is not a fault.

unavailable.description: True when this entry puts transcription_unavailable on degraded_reasons: down for 30 seconds in a row.

accelerator.description: CLOSED set. Both Intel targets (Arc and Quick Sync) are qsv: they are the same encoder and differ in placement.

encoder.description: The ffmpeg encoder every video rung is built with.

fell_back_with_device_available.description: TRUE when this box HAS an acceleration device and is encoding on the CPU anyway. It is the one field here worth alerting on: that box passes every other health check and is wrong only in capacity.

placement.description: CLOSED set. Where the device sits. unknown is a real answer and never a default: a box whose topology could not be read must not have its capacity filed under the wrong kind of GPU.

preset.description: The DISTINCT set of presets the ladder's video rungs map to in the chosen encoder's own vocabulary, comma separated in ladder order, and one value when the ladder uses one. NOT the ladder's own preset except on libx264.

reason.description: One sentence saying why this encoder and not another.

requested.description: The config value: auto, or the pinned encoder (encode.video_encoder for video_engine, jobs.video_encoder for jobs_video_engine).

usable.description: False only for a pin that failed at boot. encoder then names the PIN, never a fallback: the workload is refused (publishes encoder_unavailable, job submissions 503 encoder_unavailable) until the cause is fixed or the key is set to auto and tmesis restarts.

destination_ref.description: The effective storage.destinations name the recording is held for, or null. Never set together with destination.

destination.description: An absolute path, told and never derived; an empty string is 422. Omitted or null is the node default, and an empty node default keeps the file local. Setting it beside a destination_ref (sent or stored) is 422.

destination_ref.description: The name of a storage.destinations entry on this node (422 on a name it does not have); the recording is held for a told key there, as the config key of the same name does. An empty string is 422. Omitted or null is the node default. Setting it beside a destination (sent or stored) is 422: send the other as null to switch.

enabled.description: Capture the publisher's bytes verbatim. Omitted or null is the node's recording.ingest.enabled (role dependent). Patchable mid-show (live): on opens a new part now, off finalizes the open one now.

retention_hours.description: Local sweep age in hours, counted from registration, 1 or more (422 below that). Omitted or null is the node default.

arrival_gap_max_seconds.description: the largest wall clock gap between two reads off the publisher over rate_window_seconds, null before two reads or once the window holds none; the same reads feed tmesis_ingest_arrival_gap_seconds

bitrate_bps.description: a rate over rate_window_seconds, recomputed on every read; NOT an average since the session started

dropped_bytes_total.description: Payload bytes of inbound media dropped (SRT loss is an estimate; late SRT packets have no byte count; RTMP overflow is the ingest ring's eviction). Until v0.9.0 this field repeated dropped_packets_total.

dropped_packets_total.description: inbound packets the transport reported lost, late, discarded or undecryptable (SRT) or evicted by the ingest ring (RTMP, reason overflow): the sum of drops[]

rate_window_seconds.description: the window bitrate_bps is computed over

ts_cc_errors_total.description: MPEG-TS continuity counter errors in the received container, one per PID per hole: the input integrity signal, independent of the transport's own drop counters; always 0 on RTMP

path.description: Relative to the generation; never a local filesystem path.

publish_order.description: 0 media, init, caption segments and sidecars; 1 playlists; 2 the replay master. Earlier groups complete before later ones at every target.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; send it back as cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

state.description: queued for a new job; an idempotent repeat answers the existing job's state.

class.description: permanent is never retried by the node or the control plane; transient was already retried by the node up to jobs.max_attempts.

code.description: The failure, from API.md 9.11's closed vocabulary (source_unreadable, source_changed, source_unsupported, disk_insufficient, package_incomplete, timeout, cancelled, ...).

retryable.description: Whether resubmitting the same job could succeed.

stage.description: The stage it happened in. Absent for a failure outside any stage (a cancel of a queued job).

completed_at.description: When it reached a terminal state; null until then.

error_code.description: A failed or cancelled job's error.code (API.md 9.11); null otherwise. GET the job for the whole error.

percent.description: 0 to 100 within the current stage; 0 when not running.

stage.description: The current stage of a running job; null otherwise.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; send it back as cursor for the next page. Null on the last page. Bound to the state filter.

error.description: Why this output failed. An optional output (audio, thumbnails, transcript) may fail while the job completes.

generation.description: The output's artifact generation (a ULID), null until it is created.

mode_counts.description: thumbnails: images per selection mode (interval, at_seconds, at_percent, random), before deduplication.

provider.description: transcript: the batch provider that transcribed it; absent when no provider answered and on every other kind.

rung.description: mp4: the ladder rung this entry is.

seed.description: thumbnails: the random_count seed, so the pick is reproducible.

state.description: pending: not started; held: being written locally; finalized: inventory frozen and its told targets filed as revision 1; completed: every object of that plan delivered (landed); failed: an optional output that failed (error says why) or the required one the job failed on.

url.description: Where the output lands at its FIRST told target, s3://<bucket>/<key>: the HLS entry names the asset's master (playlist.m3u8 unless told otherwise), an mp4 entry its rung's file, a thumbnails entry the prefix. A report: the filed plan is where the bytes go.

video_only.description: hls_ladder or mp4 from a source with no audio: the master names no audio group and the MP4 has no audio track.

reason.description: Why, 1 to 200 bytes, shown verbatim in health, doctor and the jobs.paused webhook.

until.description: RFC 3339: when the pause ends by itself. null or absent: until DELETE. A time already past is stored and simply inactive.

paused.description: true while the pause is active: no queued job is claimed, running jobs finish.

set_at.description: Present while paused: when the pause was last written.

source.description: Present while paused. fleet: the control plane's desired state (jobs_pause). api: this route.

until.description: Present while paused: when the pause ends by itself, null until cleared.

stage.description: The running claim's stage; null while not running.

endpoint.description: Absolute http or https URL without userinfo, query or fragment. Omitted is AWS regional resolution.

destination_ref.description: A storage.destinations entry the node reads with that destination's credential profile. Requires key.

key.description: The source object's key in that destination, bucket-relative.

upload_id.description: RESERVED at v1: a resumable upload the node holds. Any value answers 422 source_not_supported.

url.description: An HTTPS URL the node can GET, presigned or public. Its query string is never echoed.

bytes.description: The source's size once the fetch learned it; absent while unknown.

destination_ref.description: The storage.destinations entry the source was read from, with key.

key.description: The source object's key in that destination.

url.description: The HTTPS source, with its query string (a presigned signature) removed.

attempts.description: Crashes, boot requeues and transient stage failures: what jobs.max_attempts judges.

evictions.description: Live preemptions; they never fail a job.

outputs.description: One entry per output (an mp4 output one per rung), each naming its generation once created.

destination_ref.description: A destination in this node's storage.destinations, resolved at submission.

id.description: A caller-minted ULID, unique in the job.

key.description: audio and probe: the complete bucket-relative object key.

master_name.description: hls_ladder only: the master's remote basename, ending .m3u8. Omitted is playlist.m3u8.

prefix.description: hls_ladder, mp4, thumbnails and transcript: the complete bucket-relative prefix; empty is the bucket root.

signed.description: A caller-owned bucket whose requests the caller signs (API.md 12a.4). No credential reaches the node.

detail.description: A short fact to act on: a state, a stream, an event name. Never a payload.

dropped_updates_unknown_stream.description: accounting updates for a stream this node never opened: a caller bug, visible rather than logged

go_heap_alloc_bytes.description: the Go runtime's own heap accounting, NOT process RSS; read process_resident_memory_bytes from /metrics for that

go_sys_bytes.description: memory the Go runtime obtained from the OS, NOT process RSS

invalid_updates.description: accounting updates refused as malformed: a caller bug, visible rather than logged

suppressed_streams.description: streams dropped from tracking at the cardinality cap: a caller bug, visible rather than logged

rungs.description: The ladder's rungs to remux to MP4, each one of the ladder's video rungs. Omitted is every video rung.

markers.description: Every marker told on this stream, oldest first; [] when none.

program_date_time.description: That segment's EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME, RFC3339 UTC. The tag's START-DATE is the boundary at its end (a now marker) or the told instant.

rendition.description: The rung whose playlists carry the tag.

segment_index.description: The segment the tag was written in front of: its file name under <rung>/.

at.description: The told instant, null for now.

complete.description: Every media rendition carries the tag. false on a placed marker means the session drained before every rendition cut again; placements say which do.

placed_at.description: When the node recorded the landing. null until placed.

placements.description: One per rendition carrying the tag; [] until placed.

scte35.description: The told splice_info_section, upper case hex without 0x, null for none.

session.description: The publish session the marker was told to.

start_date.description: The tag's START-DATE, identical on every rendition. null until placed.

state.description: queued: waiting for the next cut. placed: in the playlists. expired: queued when its session ended, so it never landed.

at.description: RFC3339, the tag's START-DATE verbatim, landed on the segment boundary nearest it. Omitted or null is now: the START-DATE is the boundary the next cut closes. More than one target duration in the past, or more than a day ahead, is 422.

class.description: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$, the tag's CLASS. Omitted is com.hackney.tmesis.scte35.

duration_seconds.description: 0 to 86400, rendered as DURATION. Omitted writes no DURATION. For an in carrying scte35 it MUST be the actual out-to-in duration (RFC 8216bis 4.4.5.1.1); for an out it is what the caller dispatched.

id.description: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,127}$. Omitted mints a ULID. Rendered as the tag's ID. Unique per publish SESSION: re-POSTing the same request under an id is idempotent (200), a different request under it is 409 marker_exists, and a new session of the stream may reuse it.

kind.description: out is the SCTE-35 splice out (the break starts), in the splice in (it ends). An in is its OWN marker with its own id and tag.

scte35.description: The caller's splice_info_section as hex, 0x optional, at most 4099 bytes, rendered as SCTE35-OUT (out) or SCTE35-IN (in). Validated as hex only: the node never parses or mints SCTE-35. Omitted writes neither attribute; the tag then carries CLASS and X-TMESIS-KIND.

error.description: Why the master failed; null unless state is failed.

sources.description: The source generations in join order.

state.description: queued: journaled, waiting its turn (one remux at a time per node). running: the remux is under way (a restart runs it again). completed: the MP4 is finalized and its plan filed; the upload's progress is the generation's transfer plan. failed: terminal, error says why; the sources are untouched.

request_id.description: A caller-minted ULID, unique per stream. An exact retry returns the original generation (200), the same id with another body is 409 request_conflict.

sources.description: 1 to 64 recording_ingest generation ids of THIS stream, each listed once. They are joined in the order of their recordings' start, whatever order they are listed in.

target.description: One target in the transfer plan's shape with artifact recording_master: destination_ref or signed (without authorizations: supply them by refresh when transfer.authorization_required names the object), and key, the complete bucket-relative object key, used verbatim.

credential_profile.description: The profile NAME the target signs with; never credential bytes. Null for a signed target.

authorization_available.description: Whether signed requests for this object are installed on this node. They live in memory only: a restart loses them, and the object waits for the next refresh.

authorization_required.description: The signed operations a waiting signed object needs next (put, initiate, parts, complete, abort, head). Empty for a configured target.

completion_body_sha256.description: The frozen completion body hash, for a payload-bound signature; null until every part is complete.

etag.description: The provider's ETag. Not a checksum.

object_key.description: The exact told key this object is written to. No node identity is inserted.

part_size_bytes.description: The effective part size once a multipart layout is recorded; null before.

action.description: override waives exactly every incomplete target; discard waives every target.

inventory_sha256.description: The generation's inventory. Empty, with plan_revision 0 and waived_targets [], only for the discard of an ABANDONED generation: held, never finalized, its session ended, no writer, recovery or transfer holding it.

request_id.description: A caller-minted ULID, shared with release in one idempotency family.

waived_targets.description: Target ids of the named revision. [] for a discard of an empty plan. Unknown, duplicate or omitted required ids are 422.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; send it back as cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

expected_revision.description: The revision this request replaces; 0 replaces the baseline. A new request against another revision is 409 transfer_plan_stale.

reason.description: Why this revision, at most 1024 bytes. Optional; omitted and an explicit empty string are different requests.

request_id.description: A caller-minted ULID. The node hashes the request; an exact retry returns the original revision, the same id with another body is 409 request_conflict.

current.description: Whether this revision is still the current one. An exact duplicate returns its historical revision, and this says whether a later one replaced it.

request_id.description: The request that created this revision; baseline for revision 0.

destination_ref.description: A destination in this node's storage.destinations, resolved once at acceptance.

id.description: A caller-minted ULID, unique in the plan.

key.description: A one-file generation's complete bucket-relative object key (a recording, job_audio, job_probe). Its extension does not convert the container.

master_name.description: The master's remote basename for an HLS target, ending .m3u8. Omitted is the generation's own master name: playlist.m3u8 for hls_sealed (since v0.8.0; it was vod.m3u8) and for job_hls. Maps the key only; local files and manifest bytes are unchanged.

prefix.description: The complete bucket-relative prefix of an HLS target (hls_sealed, job_hls) or a files target (job_mp4, job_thumbnails, job_transcript); empty is the bucket root. It replaces the destination's live prefix.

credential_profile.description: The profile NAME the target signs with; never credential bytes. Null for a signed target.

key.description: The told object key of a recording target; null for HLS.

master_name.description: The replay master's remote name for an HLS target; null for a recording.

prefix.description: The told prefix of an HLS target, replacing (not extending) the destination's live prefix; empty is the bucket root; null for a recording.

expires_at.description: When the grant stops covering anything. At this instant a connected monitor no other live grant covers is closed within five seconds (grant_expired).

id.description: The grant's ULID: the handle PATCH and DELETE take.

ips.description: The covered addresses in canonical form (IPv4 dotted quad, IPv6 compressed).

streams.description: The covered stream ids; null covers every stream on this node.

ips.description: The producer addresses the grant covers, IPv4 or IPv6, 1 to 16, no CIDR, no zone, not unspecified and not multicast. Send every family the panel was seen on (its IPv4 and its IPv6): the WHEP offer may arrive over either. An IPv4-mapped IPv6 address is stored as its IPv4 form; duplicates are dropped.

labels.description: Opaque string-to-string map the node never interprets, echoed on every read so the control plane can find its own grants. At most 16 keys, 64-byte keys, 256-byte values.

streams.description: The stream ids the grant covers, 1 to 64, each ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,127}$. Omitted or null covers every stream on this node; an empty list is 422, never read as every stream.

ttl_seconds.description: How long the grant lives from now, 60 to 86400 seconds. Extend it with PATCH rather than asking for more.
The grant's new life from now, 60 to 86400 seconds: expires_at becomes now plus this, whether that is later or earlier than before. Monitors the grant covers keep running.

enabled.description: Whether the session runs the preview tap (next_session: the tap changes the ffmpeg argv). Omitted or null is the node's preview.enabled.

max_monitors.description: The cap on concurrent WHEP monitors, 1 or more (live: read at every join, never kicks a monitor already watching). Omitted or null is the node's preview.max_monitors.

ingest.description: The ingest artifact: exactly what the publisher sent, pre-ladder (final plan 5.9a).

enabled.description: Omitted or null starts the destination, which is what POSTing one asks for; false adds it parked.

feed.description: What the destination is sent: auto (the default: the copy when the source suits the destination, the top ladder rung when it does not and the node encodes), ingest (the publisher's bytes as sent), or rung:<name> (a video rung of one of this node's ladders plus its audio, with no second encode). The prefixes are lower case; a rung name is letters, digits, - and _, not starting with - or _. An unknown rung is 422.

id.description: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,127}$, no dots; stop is reserved. Omitted mints a ULID. Re-POSTing an id you own is idempotent (200).

url.description: srt://, rtmp:// or rtmps:// with a host. A CREDENTIAL: echoed back redacted and never logged.

enabled.description: Park (false) or start (true) the destination on the running show. Omitted or null leaves it.

feed.description: A new feed (auto, ingest, or rung:<name>, as on create). On a running show the destination is REPLACED, relay.stopped then relay.started, because it is a different stream to the same place. Omitted or null leaves it.

url.description: A new destination URL, srt://, rtmp:// or rtmps:// with a host, applied to the running show. Omitted or null leaves it.

feed.description: The feed as configured: auto, ingest, or rung:<name>.

feed_resolved.description: What this publish session sends: ingest or rung:<name>. Empty while the stream is idle, while the destination waits on the session's source, or when the session refused it.

request_id.description: A caller-minted ULID, shared with override in one idempotency family.

streams.description: The FULL revocation list, each entry a stream id (422 on any other charset). It replaces whatever was in force; omitted or null replaces it with nothing.

unit.description: the unit of depth_fragments, capacity_fragments and dropped_fragments_total on this entry: bytes on the ingest ring, fragments on every per-rung ring

draining.description: Whether a drain had already begun. A drain under way seals the sessions and windows it has not yet ended; those it already held stay held.

seal_on_drain.description: Always true: the next drain (SIGTERM, systemctl stop or restart) seals every live session and every waiting window into its replay. It cannot be taken back; a restart of the service starts with it off.

latency_ms.description: the SRT receive latency this publisher's connection was negotiated to, in milliseconds: the larger of the node's ingest.srt.latency_ms floor and the publisher's own setting; 0 for RTMP, which has no such window

authorizations.description: Optional initial signed requests, one per inventory path, bound to the revision this plan creates (plan_revision = expected_revision + 1, authorization_revision 1). Validated against the prospective plan before the commit (a bad one refuses the request and commits nothing) and installed after it, as a refresh would install them. Never stored, never part of the request hash. A crash between commit and install leaves the object waiting_authorization for a refresh.

endpoint.description: Absolute http or https URL without userinfo, query or fragment. Omitted is AWS regional resolution.

url.description: A presigned URL. A credential: never stored, logged or echoed.

audio_codec.description: the source's audio codec in ffprobe's spelling (aac, opus, mp3), none when the probe found no audio track, null when the source was not probed

bitrate_bps.description: the ingest block's window rate, repeated here so the specs read as one block

fps.description: the source rate snapped to the standard set, as a rational string (30000/1001); null when it did not snap and the ladder's rates applied as written

callback_url.description: Where this job's job.* events, and its generations' artifact.* and transfer.* events, are delivered. Omitted or null is the node's webhooks.url.

destination.description: REMOVED: replaced by targets. destination.origin answers 422 destination_not_supported; any other value answers 422 validation_failed.

idempotency_key.description: API.md section 7: a repeat returns 200 with the existing job, a completed one included. At most 255 bytes.

labels.description: Opaque map echoed in every job event. At most 16 keys, 64-byte keys, 256-byte values.

ladder.description: A ladder in encode.ladders. Required when hls_ladder or mp4 is requested.

outputs.description: One or more of hls_ladder, mp4, audio, thumbnails, probe, transcript, each at most once. storyboard and bif answer 422 output_not_supported naming E8, channel_ready naming E4.

priority.description: Orders the local queue; never preempts live work. Omitted is normal.

targets.description: Where each output goes: a map from an output in outputs to one or more told targets. Every output needs one, and a target for an output not asked for is 422.

timeout_seconds.description: Running time allowed, 60 to 172800, counted only while the job runs: an eviction or a requeue stops the clock. Omitted is 21600.

captions.description: The live captions object (docs/API.md 9.4). Objects merge one level deep on a PATCH; every field is next_segment.

dvr_window_seconds.description: RESERVED at v1: a value on a create, or any mention on a PATCH, answers 501 naming M4. The effective value is 0, the full window.

fallback.description: The fallback object (docs/API.md 9.4). Only end_seconds is acted on by this build. Objects merge one level deep on a PATCH.

labels.description: Opaque string-to-string map the node never interprets, echoed in every webhook for this stream. At most 16 keys, 64-byte keys, 256-byte values. Null on a PATCH unsets to {}.

ladder.description: A ladder in encode.ladders, or 422 on a name this node does not have. Omitted resolves to encode.default_ladder; null on a PATCH unsets a stored value (next_session).

min_key_epoch.description: Reject publish keys below this epoch, 0 or greater (docs/API.md 8.2). Omitted or null is no floor at all, which is not the same as a floor of 0.

preview.description: The low-delay preview object (docs/API.md 9.4). Objects merge one level deep on a PATCH.

recording.description: The recording object: the ingest copy (docs/API.md 9.4). The told master is a request, POST .../masters, never a per-stream setting. Objects merge one level deep on a PATCH.

relays.description: Told forward destinations, each as POST .../relays takes it. WRITE ONLY: read them on GET .../relays. On a PATCH the array REPLACES what this record provisioned, and null is the same instruction as [] (provision none); omitted leaves the set alone.

segment_seconds.description: 1 to 30, and a multiple of every video rung's keyframe_seconds on the effective ladder (422 otherwise). Omitted is the ladder's own; null on a PATCH unsets the override (next_session).

webhook_url.description: This stream's webhook URL. Null (or omitted) means the node default from webhooks.url; an empty string is 422.

at_percent.description: Offsets as a fraction of duration, 0 to 100.

count.description: Caps the grid sample to N evenly spaced frames, N >= 1.

interval_seconds.description: A grid sample, one frame every N seconds, N > 0. Omitted is 10.

random_count.description: N uniformly random offsets, 0 to 1000; the seed is reported.

width.description: Output width in pixels, 16 to 3840, even. Omitted is 640.

end.description: Seconds from the session's media origin, millisecond precision.

program_date.description: The cue's wall-clock start, RFC3339 UTC with milliseconds, so a hit in an index maps back to a second of the DVR.

provider.description: The STT provider that produced this cue: deepgram or self_hosted, never empty. A stream whose captions moved to its fallback provider and back has cues from both in one transcript.

seq.description: The journal's per (stream, session, lang) sequence number, the same identifier the VTT cues carry; pass the last one seen as since to tail.

speaker.description: The provider's cue-level diarisation label, present only when it gave one.

start.description: Seconds from the session's media origin (the audio rendition's first EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME), millisecond precision.

formats.description: Any of vtt, srt and json. Omitted is all three.

language.description: An RFC 5646 tag, or omitted for the node's transcription.language.

provider.description: deepgram or self_hosted, equal to the node's transcription.batch_provider, or omitted for it.

cues.description: One row per final cue, in sequence order. Never null: an empty transcript is [].

provider.description: The provider of the first cue in this response (with since, the first cue above it), or the stream's provider (the node's transcription.provider) when the response has no cue; cues[].provider names each.

session.description: The publish session the cues belong to.

punctuated_word.description: The token as it appeared in the rendered text, for display.

speaker.description: The provider's word-level diarisation label, null when it gave none.

next_cursor.description: Opaque, and bound to the revision read. A cursor from a replaced revision answers 409 transfer_plan_stale.

adminToken.description: The admin token (api.admin_token), the one credential the admin listener has (docs/API.md section 5). Required on every operation that does not say otherwise; a missing, malformed or wrong token is 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer.
